FireKeepers Casino Hotel is operated by the Nottawaseppi Huron Band of Potawatomi Indians, a tribal operator rather than a national brand. BettingUSA reported on 2021-07-14 that the tribe was the 13th operator approved by the Michigan Gaming Control Board and went live soon after, with services from NYX Digital. That article names no welcome offer.

DraftKings takes Michigan bets through the Bay Mills Indian Community's licence (Bay Mills Resort & Casino), with DraftKings as the platform provider, on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.
FanDuel's Michigan licence comes through MotorCity Casino, with FanDuel as the platform provider, on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.
BetMGM's Michigan licence comes through MGM Grand Detroit, on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.

Caesars takes Michigan bets through the Grand Traverse Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians (Turtle Creek Casino & Hotel), with Caesars / World Series of Poker named as the platform, on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.

The Michigan Gaming Control Board approved bet365 on 2026-04-17 as the platform provider for the Little Traverse Bay Bands of Odawa Indians (Odawa Casino in Petoskey), replacing PokerStars, which had left the Michigan market.

Fanatics takes Michigan bets through the Lac Vieux Desert Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians (Northern Waters Casino Resort), on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.

Hard Rock Bet, run by Seminole Hard Rock Digital, launched in Michigan on 2025-12-02 through the Hannahville Indian Community (Island Resort & Casino), replacing 888 VHL, which had left the Michigan market.
BetRivers takes Michigan bets through the Little River Band of Ottawa Indians (Little River Casino Resort), on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.

betPARX runs in Michigan as Play Gun Lake, for the Gun Lake Tribe (Gun Lake Casino), with BetPARX Casino as the platform provider on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.

Eagle Casino & Sports is the Saginaw Chippewa Indian Tribe's own sportsbook (Soaring Eagle Casino & Resort), on a GAN platform, on the Michigan Gaming Control Board's list of authorized platform providers.
